title: Aura Music public resource guide
description: Public navigation and read-only metadata for Aura Music.

resources.title: Home and Library
resources.description: Sign in through the browser interface to browse and search the music library, play music, and manage personal playlists.

resources.title: Listen Together
resources.description: Start a shared listening room, or join using a room code or invite link and a display name. Rooms provide shared playback, a shared queue, and chat through their own public join/create page.

resources.title: Read-only artist directory
resources.description: Public artist profiles keyed by normalized aliases, plus track-artist name corrections and a directory revision.

responseFields.artists: Object mapping normalized artist alias keys to saved public profiles. An artist can appear under several aliases; profile.key is its canonical key. Profile fields are key, name, img, bio, genres, social, updated, version, source, imgOverride, and bioOverride. The independent override flags preserve manual values and explicit clears; automatic enrichment is cached separately. Optional metadata may be empty.
responseFields.trackArtists: Object mapping track identifiers to corrected artist display names. Identifiers use vid:<videoId> when available, otherwise hf:<path>.
responseFields.revision: Numeric revision of the artist directory.

resources.crawlerPolicy: The site's robots.txt disallows crawling /api/, including this publicly readable directory.
